content_patterns: Money formatted Indonesian-style with dot thousands separator and 'Rp' prefix ('Rp 4.250.000'); expenses shown as '- Rp 85.000'. Uppercase micro-labels ('TOTAL EXPENSE', date headers '14 SEP'). Section headers in plain Title Case ('Category Breakdown', 'Recent Transactions'). Transactions grouped chronologically by date, newest first. Per-category status uses dot + label + right-aligned value pattern. 'Remaining' framed positively in green.
notable_interactions: Left/right chevrons imply navigating between budget periods. Progress bar implies budget utilization visualization. Donut chart legend rows align percentages right. Transaction rows imply tappable detail views. Bottom nav shows active state via filled blue pill on 'Expenses'. Content cut off behind fixed bottom nav implies scrollable transaction list.
